# IBM Plex Mono

Regular and Medium are bundled in `website/src/main/resources/static/fonts`.
They include Cyrillic and are served locally.

Source: [Google Fonts, IBM Plex Mono](https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/main/ofl/ibmplexmono).
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1, reproduced in `OFL.txt`.
